title: fix(scripts): spell pnpm flags so a global pnpm 11+/12 frontend parses them (--config.production=false, --silent)
body:
## Problem

A contributor whose globally installed pnpm is a newer `@pnpm/exe` frontend (11.x / 12.x) cannot get `pnpm dev` past `check:console-sha` once the objectui pin moves. The repo pins `packageManager: pnpm@10.31.0`, and `pnpm --version` dutifully reports `10.31.0` — but the new frontend parses the argv itself (clap-style) **before** it hands off to the pinned version, and it rejects two spellings this repo's scripts use:

| spelling | where | new frontend says |
|---|---|---|
| `pnpm install … --prod=false` | `scripts/build-console.sh` (`pnpm objectui:build`) | `error: unexpected value 'false' for '--prod' found; no more were expected` — exit 2, nothing installed |
| `pnpm -s SCRIPT` | `packages/spec/scripts/check-generated.ts` (every `check:generated` gate), `scripts/check-regen-pending.mjs` (the `pre-commit` regen gate), `ownerRunCommand({ silent })` | `error: unexpected argument '-s' found` — exit 2, which those callers read as "stale" |

CI never sees it: Corepack runs the real pnpm 10.31 binary directly, which accepts all of these.

## Change

- `build-console.sh`: `--prod=false` → `--config.production=false`.
- Every spawned `pnpm -s` → `pnpm --silent` (the long form of the same flag): `check-generated.ts`, `check-regen-pending.mjs`, `regen-artifacts.mjs` `ownerRunCommand`, and the self-test pin for it in `git-merge-regen.mjs`. Comments that describe the spawn follow; two comments that record a historical measurement taken with `pnpm -s` are left as written.
- `dispatch-gates.mjs` names `pnpm -s ${script}` as a live specimen of the shell-form class; the specimen and its self-test fixture string now read `--silent`.

No workflow change: every `.github/workflows/**` call already spells `--silent`.

## Evidence

All probes in a scratch workspace pinned to `packageManager: pnpm@10.31.0`, run with both binaries: **OLD** = the real pnpm 10.31.0 `@pnpm/exe` binary (what CI runs), **NEW** = the global `@pnpm/exe` 12.3.4 frontend.

**Install: which spelling parses on both AND still installs devDependencies.** One `dependency` + one `devDependency`; `dev=` is whether the devDependency landed. First, the controls — what actually turns production mode on under pnpm 10.31 (measured, OLD, no flag):

| context | dev |
|---|---|
| nothing | yes |
| `NODE_ENV=production` | **yes** — pnpm 10 does not skip devDependencies on NODE_ENV alone |
| `npm_config_production=true` | no |
| `.npmrc` `production=true` | no |
| `--prod` | no |

Then each candidate, against the two contexts that do skip devDependencies (identical rows for both contexts, so shown once):

| spelling | OLD | NEW |
|---|---|---|
| (none) | rc 0, dev **no** | rc 0, dev **no** |
| `--prod=false` | rc 0, dev yes | **rc 2**, unexpected value |
| `--production=false` | rc 0, dev yes | **rc 2**, unexpected value |
| `--no-production` | rc 0, dev yes | **rc 2**, unexpected argument |
| `--no-prod` | rc 0, dev yes | rc 0, dev yes |
| `--config.production=false` | rc 0, dev yes | rc 0, dev yes |

`--config.production=false` is chosen over `--no-prod` because the new frontend's own help documents `--config.KEY=VALUE` as a universal rc-option, and it names the exact setting being overridden.

**Run: `--silent` is byte-identical to `-s`.** For a root script and a `--filter`ed one, each both passing and failing (exit 3 / 4): stdout, stderr and exit code of `OLD -s` compared with `cmp` against `OLD --silent` and `NEW --silent` — 8/8 identical (`--reporter=silent` also 8/8). Control: `-s` vs no flag differs, so the comparison is live. `--loglevel=silent` is NOT equivalent (still prints the `> pkg script` header).

**Sweep: nothing else the repo spells is rejected.** Every other option shape the repo's scripts pass to pnpm (`--filter`/`--filter=`, `-r list --depth -1 --json`, `exec … -e`, trailing script args such as `--maxWorkers=2 --update -e x`, `run x -- --y`, `install --no-frozen-lockfile` / `--offline`, `pack --pack-destination … --silent`, `store path --silent`, `-v`) parses identically under OLD and NEW.

**Repo, under the global 12.3.4 shim, no PATH workaround** (`command -v pnpm` → `~/Library/pnpm/bin/pnpm`):

| command | before (main `0326b32952`) | after (this branch) |
|---|---|---|
| `pnpm objectui:build` | exit 2 at the objectui install | rc 0 — install ran (`Packages: +1566`, devDependencies included), console dist built; `pnpm check:console-sha` then passes, so `pnpm dev` gets past it |
| `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:generated` | rc 1, **14/14 gates red**, each `unexpected argument '-s'` | rc 0, 14/14 up to date |
| `node scripts/check-regen-pending.mjs --self-test` | rc 1 (the stub-gate cases red) | rc 0 |
| `node scripts/git-merge-regen.mjs --self-test` | — | rc 0 |
| `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --self-test` | — | rc 0, 2144 cases |

The "before" column is the same command with only the touched file restored from `main` into the working tree, after the fix was committed.

**Repo, under the real pnpm 10.31.0 binary first on PATH (what CI runs):** `check:generated` rc 0 (14/14), `pnpm check:merge-driver` rc 0, `pnpm objectui:build` rc 0. (In that run the objectui install was a no-op over the already-populated cache tree; the install semantics under 10.31 are the scratch table above.)

`eslint` over the six changed JS/TS files: clean. `bash -n scripts/build-console.sh`: clean.

## Notes

- No changeset: only `scripts/**` and `packages/spec/scripts/**` change, and neither ships in any published package (`@objectstack/spec`'s `files` does not include `scripts/`) — `skip-changeset`.
